summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K announcing a $1,000,000,000 issuance of preferred securities contingently convertible into ordinary shares, qualifying as Additional Tier 1 capital under solvency regulations. The securities carry a 7.125% distribution rate until May 2033, then reset at 5-year UST plus 298.5 bps. The issuance excludes pre-emptive rights and is not directed at retail investors. Listing on NYSE is requested. Board reports and an independent expert's report have been issued and will be posted on BBVA's website. The closing is expected May 8, 2026. This is a routine capital management transaction, not a special situation.
